metadata.title: That 2-kill moment Valorant said ‘You’re lucky, not good’
metadata.description:
Clicked like I had a plan, but nope.
Enemy probably reinstalling out of confusion.
Valorant logic giving out kills like candy on Halloween.
Who needs aim when RNG is on your side?

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but you still get the kills!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
